content.title: FCC Orders California to Stop Enforcing Carrier of Last Resort Rules
content.caption: The Federal Communications Commission ordered California to stop enforcing its Carrier of Last Resort rules against AT&T.

slides.heading: FCC Orders California to Stop Enforcing Carrier of Last Resort
slides.text: The Federal Communications Commission ordered California to stop enforcing its Carrier of Last Resort rules against AT&T.

slides.heading: AT&T's Request
slides.text: AT&T requested the FCC to stop enforcing its Carrier of Last Resort rules against California.
